desc: 雾青绿石灰岩详情页，多层剑麻猫爬架十一镜从主张到收口
leaf: 猫用多层猫爬架（木纹平台塔身+剑麻缠绕立柱+拱顶小屋+圆环通道+斜梯+顶部吊球）
name: 雾青石灰岩猫爬架立面款

shots.intent: 整版雾青加瓷白双行主标题把「立式攀爬塔＝一只架子管住跳、磨、睡」的品类识别一屏钉死，拿下详情页第一跳
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一双行主标题带，其下居中一枚胶囊副标语位，再下一行字距拉开的拉丁 kicker 装饰位

shots.intent: 两行三列同构圆孔把六条主张拆成一眼可读的清单，一秒交代「为什么是这台爬架」
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带与三点簇，六孔下方各一枚等距短标签位与一枚线性图标

shots.intent: 把「在家无事可做、家具被磨、无处高卧」三条日常摩擦排成同构竖井，让买家先对号入座
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带与其下一行副标语，三井底端各一条等距短标签位

shots.intent: 用高 45 度俯视把爬架放进真实客厅动线，回答「摆我家好不好看、占不占地方」
shots.textZone: 左上留一档标题带与三点簇，其余画面不带字

shots.intent: 侧面 90 度的板边剖面让层压结构与封边自己说话，替买家判断板材做工而不做木材承诺
极低角度仰视底盘并把承载数值做成一枚独立数字牌，先把「会不会倒」这层风险拆掉
shots.textZone: 右侧石灰岩卡面上主标题、一枚大号数值占位与两行说明位

shots.intent: 近距离把缠绳密度、接缝与顶部吊球结构拍实，让磨爪位和逗猫位不需要形容词
shots.textZone: 下部一条主标题带与两枚短标签位

shots.intent: 同机位同光比的两栏把织纹包覆面与短绒垫面摆在一起，让买家自己看清两种触感面的差别
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带，两栏底端各一枚等距标签位

shots.intent: 两行两列同机位规格矩阵把可选层数摆成清单，把「选哪一档」的动作交回买家
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题带与其下一行副标语，四格底端各一枚选项标签位

shots.intent: 侧面正投影配引线标注与四行参数表，把尺寸与结构疑问在下单前一次答完
shots.textZone: 卡面顶部标题带，塔身四周四条引线数值位，右栏四行标签与占位值

shots.intent: 回到首屏机位把整塔收回龛位，最后只给一个低摩擦动作位收口整页而不承诺任何优惠
shots.textZone: 上部居主标题带与其下一道蜂蜜橡 hairline，右下角圆角按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: flat sage-green #7E9078 poster screens carrying one recessed rectangular alcove framed in #FBFAF7, pale limestone #E4E4DF rounded cards at 18px corners sitting on the same sage field, a matte plaster gallery wall with one stepped plinth, plus exactly two real photographic home screens; one background language per screen, honey-oak #C89B5D only as chips, rules and callout dots, never a fourth background language
style.direction: muted sage-and-limestone pet-furniture atelier detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight 2px line pictograms in #2C3A2A on light fields and in #FBFAF7 on sage fields, limited to one family only (scratch post with a spiral wrap, stacked tiers, house arch, ring tunnel, ladder rung, hanging ball, hand tool), seated inside plain unfilled circles, plus flat #C89B5D capsule chips with #FBFAF7 labels and hairline leader lines ending in a small solid dot; no glossy 3D orbs, no glass bubbles, no photographic paw-print textures, no light-streak beams, no motion arrows, no seals, shields or medals
style.lightingSystem: soft wraparound studio key from the upper left at 5600K with an even 5500K bounce fill, low contrast, gentle falloff, one faint raking band travelling along every board edge so the layered panel edges and the wound rope read as depth rather than gloss, and always a real contact shadow under the base plate so the tower reads under its own weight and never floats; the two home screens use daylight from a tall window on the left at 5200K with a soft pool on the floor
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent muted sage-and-limestone pet-furniture atelier ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sage-green poster field #7E9078, pale limestone card field #E4E4DF, cream-white ink and plinth top #FBFAF7, deep moss text #2C3A2A, one honey-oak chip and rule accent #C89B5D and one raw-rope beige #DCCDB2; neutral tone with no golden cast; one geometric sans family with squarish terminals for both Chinese and Latin, two-line headline lock-ups at 32-46pt in #FBFAF7 on sage fields and #2C3A2A on limestone fields, chip label 15-18pt, spec row label 16pt, one wide-tracked Latin kicker at 11-13pt in #C89B5D at most once per screen, a three-dot cluster as the only headline ornament, all copy as 「」 placeholders; infographic components limited to single-weight 2px line pictograms inside plain unfilled circles, flat #C89B5D capsule chips with #FBFAF7 labels, hairline leader lines ending in a small solid dot and the three-dot cluster, no glossy 3D orbs, no glass bubbles, no photographic paw-print textures, no light-streak beams, no motion arrows, no seals, shields or medals; the tower held at one stable slight 3/4 or straight frontal angle with constant scale, its tier count, platform outlines, rope wrap direction, house arch, ring tunnel, ladder slant, hanging ball and cushion edges true to the reference, never restyled, recoloured, added to or cropped mid-member; any cat cropped, turned away or mid-climb with its face outside the frame so no individual or breed reads, wearing no collar or clothing; card corners fixed at 18px; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand or store badge text, no QR codes, no invented tier counts, dimensions or load numbers.
noDrift: no glossy 3D orbs, glass bubbles, rendered fibre mesh, light-streak beams or 3D arrows
no unfilled grey placeholder wells and no empty certificate frames
no invented tier counts, layer heights, footprints, platform sizes, load capacities or weight limits
no solid-wood assertion and no material, grade, formaldehyde or eco certification claims beyond what the reference shows
no antibacterial, mite-proof, odour-control, warm, breathable or washable efficacy wording and no disease names
no certifications, patents, awards, inspection reports, lab numbers, ratings, warranty years or sales figures
no breed-identifiable animal face, no frontal pet portrait, no collar or clothing on any animal
no invented hammock, extra perch bed, ramp, toy, drawer or accessory not present in the reference
no brand, store or company name text, no QR codes, membership patches or promotion overlays, no human faces
style.presentationRules: the tower keeps one stable slight 3/4 or straight frontal angle and a constant scale across every screen, always standing on its own base plate with a visible contact shadow; its tier count, platform outlines, post rope wrap direction, house arch, ring tunnel, ladder slant, hanging ball and cushion edges stay true to the reference and are never restyled, recoloured, added to, removed or cropped mid-member; card corners fixed at 18px; any cat appears cropped, turned away or mid-climb with its face outside the frame so no individual reads as identifiable and no breed is recognisable, and it wears no collar, clothing or accessory absent from the product reference
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale-limestone plinth ledge #E4E4DF topped in #FBFAF7, warm oak plank floor #D8C3A2 and a low-pile neutral rug #DCCDB2 inside the home screens, bare cool concrete #CFD1CC only inside the pain-point wells; the boards always read as real layered panel edges with visible veneer lines and the posts as tightly wound fibre rope in #DCCDB2, never plastic-smoothed, never solid timber hewn from one piece
style.typography: one geometric sans family with squarish terminals for both Chinese and Latin; two-line headline lock-ups at 32-46pt in #FBFAF7 on sage fields and in #2C3A2A on limestone fields, chip label 15-18pt, spec row label 16pt, one wide-tracked Latin kicker at 11-13pt in #C89B5D used at most once per screen, a three-dot cluster as the only headline ornament, all rendered copy carried as 「」 placeholders
